你是真没见过黑社会啊（你是真没见过黑社会啊（第22页）“如果我没感应错的话……”她抬起右手，指尖朝林默左胸的方向轻轻一勾。“那个口袋里也有一枚戒指吧。小弟弟，拿出来给姐姐看看。”一股无法抗拒的法则牵引力从林默的左胸口袋中传来。那枚储物戒指，他贴身藏在心口位置、从未给任何人碰过的戒指，此刻正不受控制地从口袋中缓缓飞出。戒指表面还残留着他体温的余热，在虚空中划出一道极其细微的银白色光弧，朝虚荣女神摊开的手掌飞去。那枚戒指里只装两样东西：一部关着机的手机，和一张老妈的化验单。那是他从时间乱流里唯一抢回来的东西。殷血看到那枚戒指飞出去的瞬间便不再说话了。她不着急了，不生气了，甚至嘴角微微弯起了一个弧度。她认识林默太久了，久到能从一个眼神的变化判断出他接下来会做什么。而现在林默的眼神，和他在圣临村教堂地下室里第一次拔剑时一模一样。虚荣女神的五指已经开始收缩，那枚戒指离她的指尖只有不到一寸。然后一道暗金色的剑光在她眼前炸开。林默拔剑的速度快到连神明的动态视力都完全跟不上的程度。黑剑从剑鞘中拔出的瞬间便在空气中拉出一道极细极窄的暗金色光弧，精准地切过了她右手手腕。那只还在保持着握拢姿势的手从手腕处齐根断开。连同手指上那几枚还没戴稳的空间戒指一起飞向半空。她的法则护甲在这一剑面前形同虚设。杀戮法则是所有法则中攻击性最强的本源法则。这一剑远不是一个众生级神明能挡住的。虚荣女神甚至没有感觉到疼痛。她只是低头看着自己那只还飞在半空中的断手，看着手腕断口处喷涌而出的金色神血。她的瞳孔以一种极缓慢的速度逐渐放大。然后她看到另一只手从她断手的正下方稳稳地接住了那枚戒指。那只手的手指修长而有力，指节分明，正紧紧攥着她刚才还差一寸就能拿到的那件宝物。她顺着那只手向上看去，看到的是林默那张没有任何表情的脸。他不知什么时候已经站在她面前。两人之间的距离近到她能感受到他黑袍上残留的时间乱流气息。近到她能看到他眼底那片极其克制的、从未真正熄灭过的暗金色火焰。然后虚荣女神听到了七个字。那七个字声音不大。没有咆哮，没有嘶吼，每一个字都平静得像是在陈述一个即将发生的事实。但每一个字都带着决堤的杀意。“臭婊子，我操你妈。”

You've really never seen the underworld (You've really never seen the underworld (page 22) "If I'm not wrong..." She raised her right hand and flicked her fingertips towards Lin Mo's left chest. "There must be a ring in that pocket. Little brother, take it out and show it to your sister." An irresistible force of law came from Lin Mo's left breast pocket. . The storage ring, which he had hidden close to his heart and had never been touched by anyone, was slowly flying out of his pocket uncontrollably. The residual heat of his body temperature still remained on the surface of the ring, drawing an extremely small arc of silvery white light in the void and flying towards the open palm of the goddess of vanity. There were only two things in the ring: a hand with the phone turned off. The machine, and a test report from his mother. That was the only thing he snatched back from the turbulence of time. The moment Yin Xue saw the ring flying out, she stopped talking. She was no longer anxious, and she even curved her mouth slightly. She had known Lin Mo for so long that she could tell what Lin Mo would do next. The look in his eyes was exactly the same as when he first drew the sword in the basement of Shenglin Village. The fingers of the Goddess of Vanity had begun to shrink, and the ring was less than an inch away from her fingertips. Then a dark golden sword light exploded in front of her eyes. The speed of Lin Mo's sword draw was so fast that even the dynamic vision of the gods could not keep up. The black sword was pulled out of the scabbard. A very thin arc of dark golden light was drawn in the air, and it accurately cut through the wrist of her right hand. The hand that was still holding the hand was completely disconnected from the wrist, and flew into the air together with the few space rings on her fingers. The Law of Killing was the most offensive original law among all the laws. Then. This sword was far beyond the reach of a living being. The Goddess of Vainglory didn't even feel the pain. She just looked down at her broken hand, which was still flying in the air, and looked at the golden blood spurting out from the broken part of her wrist. Then she saw another hand steadily catching it from underneath. That ring. The fingers of that hand were slender and strong, with clear knuckles, tightly grasping the treasure that she was just an inch away from. She looked up at that hand and saw Lin Mo's expressionless face. At some point, the distance between the two was so close that she could feel the turbulent flow of time on his black robe. Breathing. So close that she could see the extremely restrained dark golden flame in his eyes. Then the Goddess of Vanity heard seven words. There was no roar or scream, and each word was as calm as stating a fact that was about to happen. But every word was full of murderous intent.
